citation: The Front Desk Review — online-booking pricing dataset, as of 2026-06-12, https://frontdeskreview.com/data/online-booking.json (CC-BY-4.0).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Always-free tier: 1 event type, 1 calendar connection, video-conferencing integrations, mobile apps and browser extensions.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $10/seat/mo at the annual-billing rate; page states 'Save 16%' annual. Second-source month-to-month rate (not on official page): $12/seat/mo. Unlimited event types, multiple calendars, HubSpot/Mailchimp/Stripe/PayPal/Zapier.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $16/seat/mo at the annual-billing rate; page states 'Save 20%' and marks this Recommended. Second-source month-to-month rate: $20/seat/mo. Adds Salesforce, round-robin, lead routing, Marketo/Pardot.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales. Page states it 'Starts at $15k/yr' as a flat annual contract; monthly USD not published, so null. Adds Microsoft Dynamics, SAML/SSO, domain control, advanced admin/security.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $20/mo billed monthly, $16/mo billed annually (20% off). 1 calendar. No set-up, cancellation or support fees. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $34/mo billed monthly, $27/mo billed annually (20% off). Up to 6 calendars/staff.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $61/mo billed monthly, $49/mo billed annually (20% off). Up to 36 calendars/staff. HIPAA compliance available with a signed BAA on this tier ('Sign BAA for HIPAA compliance').

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: For solo professionals. Priced per location; single location on Free. Includes payment processing, core appointments, online booking site, reminders, unlimited staff calendars. $0/mo confirmed on the official pricing page.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Priced per location (not per user); each location billed again. Adds cancellation policy and no-show fees, multi-staff booking, waitlist. $49/mo per location corroborated for 2026 by three independent sources (GlossGenius, Koalendar, Capterra). Free trial.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Priced per location (not per user). Adds future-bookings report, service-cost tracking, resource management. $149/mo per location corroborated for 2026 by GlossGenius, Koalendar and Capterra. Free trial.

plans.name: Square Pro
plans.notes: Custom / quote-only ('Get custom pricing'). Eligibility: businesses processing more than $250,000/yr. Custom processing fees, hardware discounts, onboarding, account management. monthlyUsd null (contact sales).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 4 users/staff logins, 200 appointments/month. Branded booking page, 1-on-1 and group classes, iOS/Android apps, email confirmations/reminders, online and in-person payments, Mailchimp/Zapier/Google Analytics. No HIPAA/BAA on this tier.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $12/user/mo billed monthly, $5/user/mo billed annually (page states no explicit percentage, so annualDiscountPct null). Unlimited users and appointments. Adds remove branding, 2-way calendar sync, SMS reminders, recurring/video appointments, API. HIPAA with a signed BAA (via Setmore Health) is available on this tier; Setmore Health pricing not publicly listed.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales. Page directs larger organisations to 'Work with us' / Contact us; no price published, so monthlyUsd null.

plans.name: Kickstart
plans.notes: $35/seat/mo at the annual-billing rate (card says 'Billed annually'). Entry self-serve per-seat tier. Client management, online scheduler, payment processing, branded portal, mobile app, SMS/email notifications. SMS credits 100 US / 20 non-US/mo. 'HIPAA Compliant + BAA' listed. Setup & installation session (45 min) is $150/session — no free session included on this tier.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $54/seat/mo at the annual-billing rate ('Billed annually'). Third-party listings report ~$65/seat/mo monthly-billed (not on the official page). Adds advanced invoices, marketing campaigns, reviews, analytics, waitlist. SMS credits 250 US / 50 non-US. 'HIPAA Compliant + BAA' listed. Setup session ($150) — 1 free 45-min session included.

plans.name: Platinum
plans.notes: Card shows $93/seat/mo ('Billed annually') alongside 'Only $110 seat/month' monthly-billed. Adds room & equipment booking, QuickBooks, Zapier, GA4. SMS credits 500 US / 100 non-US. 'HIPAA Compliant + BAA' listed. Setup session ($150) — 2 free 45-min sessions included. Team selector to 50+ seats; no hidden Enterprise tier.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free forever. 1 user, 1 connected calendar, 1 event type, 100 email reminders/mo, 1 client + 1 personal reminder template. No SMS. Email reminders only, GReminders branding.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $10/user/mo billed monthly, $8/user/mo billed annually (20% off). Additional users at the same $10/$8 rate. 320 email reminders/mo, SMS via add-on credit packs, up to 5 calendars, up to 10 event types, team scheduling with round robin.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $47/user/mo billed monthly, $39/user/mo billed annually (~17% off). Additional users $18/mo ($15 annual). 640 email reminders/mo, 320 SMS/phone credits/mo, unlimited event types, dedicated phone number, 'HIPAA Compliance w/ BAA', HubSpot/Pipedrive/ActiveCampaign, webhooks/Zapier. AI Notetaker Essentials add-on $61/$49 per user/mo; SMS packs $13 (160) to $200 (5,000).

plans.name: Custom / Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Page states 'Need Larger Plans? Have more Enterprise Needs?' with Contact Us / Get a Demo. No public price, so monthlyUsd null.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 5 members, up to 25 booked meetings/mo, up to 1 scheduling page, web-conferencing integration, cancel/reschedule. Limits confirmed verbatim on the live page. USD.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $12/member/mo billed monthly; page states 'Save 25% with an annual subscription' ($9/member/mo annual). Adds automated reminders, manual confirmation, payment collection (Stripe/PayPal), pre-fill forms, redirect, Zapier, webhooks, disable branding. USD; confirmed across three fetches.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only ('Inquire for prices'). No public price, contact-sales confirmed. Adds priority support, quarterly account reviews, advanced security.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0 forever. 1 calendar connection, 1 booking page, no credit card. 'Powered for free by YouCanBookMe' branding. Calendar sync (Google/Microsoft/Apple/Fastmail), confirmation/reminder/follow-up emails, basic analytics. USD/GBP/EUR selectable; USD shown.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Flat-rate single-user tier: 2 calendar connections, 2 booking pages, custom branding, additional notifications. monthlyUsd null — the official page renders all paid tiers as a JS-injected '$0/month' placeholder with a 'Contact Sales' button, and aggregators conflict ($7.20 vs $9 vs $14), so no figure is confirmable. annualDiscountPct 10 from the page's explicit 'Billed Yearly 10% off' toggle (also '2 Years 20% off').

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Flat-rate single-user tier above Individual: 6 calendar connections, 10 booking pages, automations, workflows, analytics, tracking pixels. monthlyUsd null — JS-injected '$0/month' placeholder on the official page; aggregators conflict ($10.40 vs $13). annualDiscountPct 10 from the 'Billed Yearly 10% off' toggle.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per-member (per-seat) tier, marked 'Most Popular': 10 calendar connections + 15+ booking pages per user, role-based access, centralized billing. monthlyUsd null — '$0/member/month' placeholder on the official page; aggregators conflict on amount and model ($14.40/member vs $18/member vs $10.80/calendar). annualDiscountPct 10 from the 'Billed Yearly 10% off' toggle.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever for individuals. Unlimited event types and bookings, calendar connections, video integrations, 14-day trial of paid features. Confirmed on the live pricing page.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $15/user/mo standard monthly-billed; the live page defaults to the yearly view showing $12/user/mo with a 'Save 25%' badge (actual reduction $15->$12 is ~20%, the page rounds to 25%). Round-robin, collective events, routing forms, team booking pages.

plans.name: Organizations
plans.notes: $37/user/mo standard monthly-billed; the live page's yearly view shows $28/user/mo with a 'Save 25%' badge (actual reduction $37->$28 is ~24%). Adds organization branding, subdomains, SAML/SSO and a 'SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001 compliance check' item (no explicit BAA offer, so baa null).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom / contact sales. Annual pricing, no published per-seat rate, so monthlyUsd null.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: $0.00. Page wording: 'Enjoy basic feature at no cost'. Up to 3 users included. Unlimited bookings, appointments, classes and a booking page.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $3.00/user/mo billed annually (the figure rendered on the live page). The monthly-billed per-user rate is JavaScript-gated and not present in the server-rendered HTML, so only the annual-billed per-user price is recorded. Annual discount advertised as 'Save up to 25%' (a maximum).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $2.25/user/mo billed annually (rendered on the live page; cheaper per-seat than Starter at higher seat counts). Monthly-billed per-user rate is JS-gated and not recorded. SMS, payment processors, 20+ language Pro booking page. 'Save up to 25%' annual maximum.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free. Booking page with unlimited bookings, multiple booking types, paid/recurring/package bookings, custom booking page, translation/localization (multi-language client booking), 1 calendar connection.

plans.name: Individual Lifetime
plans.notes: One-time lifetime payment of $29 USD (page shows original $144). Not a monthly subscription, so monthlyUsd is null and the one-time price is documented here. Adds auto meeting links (Zoom/Meet/Teams), group bookings, guest invites, AI booking assistant, custom emails, analytics, Zapier, up to 10 calendar connections.

plans.name: Agency Lifetime
plans.notes: One-time lifetime payment of $79 USD (page shows original $240). Flat fee, NOT per-user (confirmed via help article 733: flat $79, no recurring fees, unlimited team members). Adds round robin & collective meetings, team booking page, SMS reminders (US/CA), reduced branding, up to 25 calendar connections.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $12/mo or $99/yr (page shows original yearly $144; annual saves $45, ~31% off). Flat pricing, not per-seat. Adds no branding, custom domain, priority support, up to 25 calendar connections.

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: Entry tier. 1 consultant, 1 staff login, 200 bookings/month. USD; no annual discount. Same price/structure across Appointments, Classes & Courses and Tours & Activities. 30-day free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Small
plans.notes: 3 consultants, 3 staff logins, 1,000 bookings/month. USD; no annual discount.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 20 consultants, 20 staff logins, 1,000 bookings/month. USD; no annual discount.

plans.name: Large
plans.notes: 40 consultants, 40 staff logins, 2,000 bookings/month. USD; no annual discount.

plans.name: X-Large
plans.notes: Top self-serve tier. 60 consultants, 60 staff logins, 3,000 bookings/month. USD; no annual discount. Add-ons: Digital Waivers from $9/mo, SMS/FAX credits from $0.09/credit.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever, unlimited users. Group meetings/polls, a booking page and Sign-up Sheets. Currency auto-adjusts by location; USD on the US page.

plans.name: Pro (Professional)
plans.notes: Single license: $15/user/mo billed monthly, $132/user/yr billed annually (~$11/user/mo, ~26% saving). Ad-free, calendar sync with invites, booking tracking, read receipts/reminders, custom branding, 1:1 booking pages.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per-user: $19.95/user/mo billed monthly, $8.95/user/mo billed annually (~55% saving). 2-100 users. Multiple seats, centralized billing, Group Polls, shared booking pages, Sign-up Sheets, admin controls, company branding, priority support.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Flat plan (not per-seat). $24/mo billed annually, $28/mo billed monthly ('Save up to 14% with an annual plan'). Up to 2 users (secondary source). Custom booking website, unlimited notifications, email & text marketing, inventory & retail, packages & memberships. Flat 2.6% payment processing on all plans. Optional Payroll add-on $40/mo + $6/seat. Does NOT include HIPAA/Forms & Waivers (Gold+ only).

plans.name: Gold
plans.notes: Most popular. Flat plan. $48/mo annual, $56/mo monthly (~14% annual saving). Up to 9 users (secondary source). Adds Forms & Waivers (with HIPAA Compliance option), Google Booking & Reviews, automated waitlist, time tracking, room & resource management. 500 marketing texts.

plans.name: Platinum
plans.notes: Flat plan. $148/mo annual, $168/mo monthly (~12% annual saving). Teams of 10+, unlimited users. Adds team goal setting & analytics, customizable commissions, Google Marketing Analytics, 2,500 marketing texts. HIPAA Compliance available via Forms & Waivers.

plans.name: Booksy (all-inclusive)
plans.notes: Single all-inclusive plan (no feature tiers). $29.99/mo + tax covers the first user, then $20/mo per additional team member (per_seat). 14-day free trial, no card, cancel anytime. All features included: unlimited bookings (no per-booking fees), online booking, calendar/client management, marketing tools, message blasts, waitlists, gift cards, integrated payments, stats, and 2,000 free SMS/mo. Payment-processing fees separate (2.69% + $0.30 mobile/keyed, 2.49% + $0.10 card reader, 2.49% + $0.20 Tap to Pay). Boost marketing free to enable, one-time 30% fee on a Boost client's first visit. No annual discount stated.
